verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a self-hostable open-source database, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out setting; the RBAC and multi-tenancy items are adjacent data-security controls and do not count toward this story.
